content.prompt: Sketch each parabola, clearly labelling the $x$- and $y$-intercepts, the axis of symmetry and the vertex.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}y&=x^2-6x+8\\y&=(x-2)(x-4)\end{align*}$$
At $y=0$, $x=2$ or $x=4$. At $x=0$, $y=8$.
$$\begin{align*}x_{\text{axis}}&=\frac{2+4}{2}\\x_{\text{axis}}&=3\\y_{\text{vertex}}&=3^2-6(3)+8\\y_{\text{vertex}}&=-1\end{align*}$$
The vertex is $(3,-1)$. The positive coefficient of $x^2$ gives an upward-opening parabola.
